# Fozhu NZ

> Fozhu NZ offers prayer beads, mala beads and gemstone bracelets, with a Five Elements-inspired product guide and a traditional BaZi-inspired personal reading.

## Main site

- [Fozhu NZ](https://fozhu.co.nz/): Storefront, product collection, reading experience, shipping information and customer support.

## Topics

- Prayer beads and mala beads
- Gemstone and wood bead jewellery
- Five Elements as a cultural styling framework
- BaZi as a traditional cultural reading framework

Product availability, materials, prices and delivery options are shown on the storefront and confirmed during checkout. Cultural readings and element associations are for reflection and are not guaranteed predictions or professional advice.
